_comment: Perk adapter: Adamant 6.0.4 with Mysticism 2.5.0, which defines these keywords - most in the
Update.esm FormID range, so they only exist when Mysticism is installed. Mysticism's own perks
and Vokriinator Black 6.15.3 read the same keywords, so any of the three turns the file on.
Paragon 1.0.0 reads MAG_MagicDamagePoison, MAG_MagicDamageSun and MAG_MagicSummonReanimate too
(the keywords come with Apostasy Framework, which Paragon needs), so ParagonPerks.esp turns the file on.
Conditions as in vanilla.json. "formList" lines put spells into Adamant's own spell lists
(persistent ids, the same in 5.9.2 and 6.0.4); the lists were read from Adamant.esp and each rule
is what the spells already in the list have in common.
Not added, with the reason:
MAG_MagicDamageMagicka/Stamina/Bleed/Critical, MAG_StaggerSpellKeyword - Adamant's weapon and
enchantment effect categories (Twin Fury, Bastion, stances); no spell carries them
MAG_PerkScourgeExclude - Adamant puts it on spells that already carry Scourge's effect, to stop
it applying twice; on any other poison spell it would take the spell out of Scourge
MAG_MagicRegenSpell, MAG_MagicAttunementSpell - no scan field tells these apart from other
Restoration buffs (the rules tried picked quest spells)
MAG_MagicStaffEnchantment(Conc/Rune) - staff enchantments, not spells
MAG_MassReanimationKeyword, MAG_Perk*Keyword - Adamant's own perk effects
MAG_MagicDamageWeakness - read by Vokriinator Black only; left for a later rule
MAG_MagicWallSpell: Mysticism also marks the hazard's own contact damage effects. The line marks
the scripted barrier effect the spell carries; the hazard effects are not spell effects and are
not in the scan, so perks that ask about the hazard damage itself are not covered.

adapters.why: exclusion keyword. OFF: Adamant puts it on the poison spells that carry Scourge's own effect (35 of the 47 carriers here), so it stops a double application; added to others it would take them out of Scourge
illusion paralysis - Mysticism puts it on Illusion only (Vokriinator Black reads both this and MagicParalysis)
silence: an illusion curse on magicka
command: illusion control of a person or creature
bound weapons (bound shields are armor, not BoundWeapon, and stay out)
elemental shield: a self buff to an elemental resistance
health over time. OFF: the rule picked quest spells (time freeze, a Tel Mithryn teleport) and a follower spell
protective circle: a Restoration self cast whose own effect lays a hazard and that harms nothing
walls: a concentration spell whose harmful impact-hazard effect is scripted. Wall effects are Script 28 of 32 times, other sprays leaving an impact hazard 1 of 114
attunement: Mysticism's fortify-a-vital-stat self buffs. OFF: only two spells carry it and no scan field sets them apart
MAG_ConcentrationFireSpells, which Firebrand leaves out: fire damage dealt on and on. Concentration casts. The list's own members: Flames, Greater Flames, Flame Tempest, cloak and wall damage
MAG_ConcentrationFireSpells: fire damage from a cloak
MAG_ConcentrationShockSpells, which Unstable Current leaves out: shock damage dealt on and on. Concentration casts
MAG_ConcentrationShockSpells: shock damage from a cloak
